module.title: Public Profiles, Social Graph, Messaging and Moderation
module.business_purpose: A delivery-platform-style discovery and reputation layer for practitioners, practices, hospitals, diagnostic units, pharmacies, clinics and care sites. Insurers and brokers may have public information profiles only when product policy enables them. Public content is isolated from the clinical record. Reviews can be encounter-verified without making encounter identifiers public.
